title: A stretched wave
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Redshift means light is observed at longer wavelengths than its emitted wavelength. Cosmological expansion is one way to produce such a shift in distant galaxies.

objective: Use the visual model to reason about: A spectral line is observed at a longer wavelength than it was emitted. What is this change called?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: A spectral line is observed at a longer wavelength than it was emitted. What is this change called? Redshift. Redshift means light is observed at longer wavelengths than its emitted wavelength. Cosmological expansion is one way to produce such a shift in distant galaxies.
